questions.learningObjective: Identify the infinitive behind a conjugated form
questions.stem: Which infinitive does the form "scrivi" come from?

options.misconception: "conoscere" has a different conjugation pattern
"preferire" has a different conjugation pattern
"volere" has a different conjugation pattern

questions.explanation: The form "scrivi" is the present form for "tu" of "scrivere". Identifying the infinitive behind a conjugated form requires matching the stem and the person endings to the correct conjugation pattern.
questions.hint: Strip the ending and match the remaining stem to an infinitive.

options.misconception: this is the voi form of the verb, not noi
this is the loro form of the verb, not noi
this is the io form of the verb, not noi

questions.explanation: The subjunctive form of "tornare" for "noi" is "torniamo". The present subjunctive is used after expressions of doubt, wish, or necessity. It draws its stem from the third-person plural present. Selecting the wrong person ending changes who performs the action.
questions.hint: Identify the subject pronoun, then apply the subjunctive ending for that person.
